message.content:
Los Angeles (Pacific Time Zone) is normally **UTC‑8** (UTC‑7 during U.S. Daylight Saving Time).  
Berlin (Central European Time) is normally **UTC + 1** (UTC + 2 during European Daylight Saving Time).

Because the start and end dates for DST differ slightly between the U.S. and Europe, the exact offset can vary during the transition weeks:

| Period | Los Angeles | Berlin | Difference (Berlin ahead) |
|--------|-------------|--------|---------------------------|
| Standard time (both off DST) | UTC‑8 | UTC + 1 | **9 hours** |
| LA on DST, Berlin still on standard | UTC‑7 | UTC + 1 | **8 hours** |
| Both on DST | UTC‑7 | UTC + 2 | **9 hours** |
| Berlin on DST, LA back to standard | UTC‑8 | UTC + 2 | **10 hours** |

So for most of the year Berlin is **9 hours ahead of Los Angeles**. During the brief periods around the DST transitions it can be 8 or 10 hours ahead.
